detector._note: Keypoints 23-11-13 / 24-12-14 (hip-shoulder-elbow), 3D world angle. Arms hang at 20-25 and a correct raise turns at about 100. Past 110 the shoulder stops abducting and starts pressing, which is a different movement and is not counted.

stage._note: Specified by the player, 6 Sep 2026: arms down at 20-25, the raise turns at 100, more than 110 is not a lateral raise and does not count, and the arms must come back into 20-30 for the rep to land. countAt RETURN makes this a whole-cycle rule, so the rep counts on the way down rather than on the way up. Replaces a wrist-height pair in metres that was measured off a drawing, not a body. Ceiling 110: Past 110 the shoulder stops abducting and starts pressing. The player's own number, 6 Sep 2026. A ceiling makes the rep a whole cycle: it lands when the movement returns to rest, not when it first crosses the line, so a half rep cannot count.

tempo._note: measured window: topExit crossing -> bottomEnter crossing, not the full descent

cues.enter: Face the camera, arms hanging at your sides (10–20°).
cues.tooHigh: Raise the arms out to the sides to shoulder height — 90° at the shoulder.
cues.framing: I can't see your hips — step back.
